name: Cinnamon
overview: Cinnamon is recognized in Scripture as a valuable and fragrant spice, notably included among the principal ingredients for the sacred anointing oil commanded by the LORD to Moses (Exodus 30:22-23). Its aromatic quality is also highlighted in Proverbs, where it is used to perfume a bed, symbolizing beauty and delight (Proverbs 7:17). Additionally, cinnamon is listed among the luxurious goods in Revelation, emphasizing its continued significance as a precious commodity in biblical times (Revelation 18:13). These passages together illustrate cinnamon's role both in holy worship and in everyday expressions of richness and blessing.
